Looping: run some of the layers again

Unrolling the loop

Loop

x = embed(tokens)
for _ in range(3):
    x = x + layer(x)
print(x)

Unrolled

x = embed(tokens)
x = x + layer(x)
x = x + layer(x)
x = x + layer(x)
print(x)

A looped transformer is just a deeper transformer with tied weights
